claim.quote: Evidence of the Purely Leptonic Decay B- --> tau- nu_tau-bar

date.note: arXiv submission date (v1, 9 April 2006). Published as Phys. Rev. Lett. 97, 251802 (2006).

name: Evidence for the purely leptonic decay B⁻ → τ⁻ ν̅
notes: The collaboration's word for this result is 'evidence' (in the title); it is not recorded as an observation.

significance.note: The abstract states that the signal significance reached 3.5 standard deviations; the exact wording of the sentence was not captured verbatim, so a locator is given instead of a quote.

summary.plain: Belle found the first evidence that a B particle can decay straight into a tau lepton and a neutrino. Because the neutrino is invisible, the decay had to be inferred from everything else in the event.
summary.technical: First evidence for B⁻ → τ⁻ ν̅_τ in 414 fb⁻¹ at the Υ(4S) with 3.5σ significance, B = (1.79 ⁺⁰·⁵⁶₋₀.₄₉(stat) ⁺⁰·⁴⁶₋₀.₅₁(syst)) × 10⁻⁴, giving the first direct determination of the B decay constant f_B.

title: Evidence of the Purely Leptonic Decay B⁻ → τ⁻ ν̅_τ
why_it_matters: A tree-level, helicity-suppressed decay sensitive to charged-Higgs exchange; the first direct measurement of f_B|V_ub|.
